SELECT 
    SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) * 100.0 / 
    (SELECT SUM(oi2.qty * oi2.unit_price) 
     FROM order_items oi2 
     JOIN orders o ON oi2.order_id = o.id 
     WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')) AS percentage
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') 
AND (c.id = 1 OR c.id = 2 OR c.id = 3 OR c.id = 4)

SELECT 
    SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) * 100.0 / 
    (SELECT SUM(oi2.qty * oi2.unit_price) 
     FROM order_items oi2 
     JOIN orders o ON oi2.order_id = o.id 
     WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')) AS percentage
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') 
AND (c.id = 1 OR c.id = 2 OR c.id = 3 OR c.id = 4)

SELECT 
  SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS avg_order_amount
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')

SELECT 
    c.name as category_name,
    SUM(oi.qty * (oi.unit_price - p.cost)) as gross_profit
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY gross_profit DESC
LIMIT 1;
